name: bb-invoke-conformal
description: 调用 Cadence Conformal LEC (`lec`) 做逻辑等价性检查（RTL↔netlist 或 netlist↔netlist），替代开源流程缺失的 LEC 角色（netgen 只做 SPICE-LVS）。Workflow: (1) render do-file; (2) run lec -LPGXL -TCLmode -NOGui -Dofile; (3) parse Equivalent / NON-EQUIVALENT。触发场景：(1) bba-guru-synthesis post-synth 验证 RTL↔综合网表等价；(2) bba-guru-pd post-route 验证综合网表↔post-route 网表等价；(3) ECO 后证明仅改了那一处；(4) 显式 /bb-invoke-conformal。

name: bb-invoke-genus
description: Cadence Genus 25.12 逻辑综合 → ASAP7 NLDM 门级网表（多 V_T、PLE）。Stage-0 candidate-first：写 run-local logic candidate（不覆盖 canonical），可验证 strategy levers（dont_use/clock-gating，retiming 默认禁用），native 单位归一化（ps→ns），native power report 指针。Workflow: (1) render TCL (--candidate-dir + strategy); (2) run genus -files; (3) parse (--time-unit 1ps --build-id --candidate-netlist-sha)。触发：(1) bba-guru-synthesis 需生成 netlist；(2) PD 反馈 area/path 超标重综合；(3) 显式 /bb-invoke-genus。

name: bb-invoke-innovus
description: 调用 Cadence Innovus 25.12 执行统一 Place&Route（init/floorplan/place/cts/route/opt/extract/streamout/verify_drc），取代开源 Magic+QRouter+KLayout 三件套；内建 NanoRoute + ccopt + Quantus extractRC，三角 MMMC（ss/tt/ff），产出 saveDesign .enc + routed.def + GDSII + DRC/timing 报告。Workflow: (1) render TCL; (2) run innovus -files; (3) parse DRC/timing/area。触发场景：(1) bba-guru-pd 在综合网表上跑 P&R；(2) DRC/timing fail 后迭代；(3) 显式 /bb-invoke-innovus。

name: bb-invoke-jaspergold
description: 调用 Cadence JasperGold 2026.03 做形式验证：SVA 性质证明（prove/falsify/unknown）、CDC 跨时钟域违例扫描、RTL lint。开源 Babel 完全没有形式验证能力（bb-check-cdc 只是 pyverilog AST 启发式）。Workflow: (1) render SGL/TCL; (2) run jaspergold; (3) parse proven/falsified/unknown + CDC violations。触发场景：(1) bba-guru-verification 跑 SVA 性质证明；(2) bb-check-cdc 用 JasperGold CDC 引擎替代 AST 启发式；(3) RTL lint；(4) 显式 /bb-invoke-jaspergold。

name: bb-invoke-klayout
description: 调用 KLayout 0.30.8 执行 GDSII 导出（stream out）、GDS-level DRC、或导出后 verify。PD 流程末尾产出最终 .gds（signoff 产物）。触发场景：(1) bba-guru-pd routed 后 GDS export；(2) GDS 层 DRC 检查；(3) 导出后 verify；(4) 显式 /bb-invoke-klayout。

name: bb-invoke-magic

name: bb-invoke-opensta

name: bb-invoke-physverify
description: 物理验证入口（in-design DRC/connectivity；可升级到 Pegasus/Calibre deck）：替代开源 magic-DRC + klayout-DRC + netgen-LVS 的 harness 位置。⚠️ 本机无 standalone Pegasus/Calibre，默认只跑 Innovus 内建 verify_drc + verifyConnectivity + verifyGeometry；逻辑等价委托给 bb-invoke-conformal，不等于 foundry physical LVS。带 --deck innovus|pegasus|calibre 开关（默认 innovus），deck=pegasus/calibre 但二进制缺失时返回 DECK_BINARY_NOT_INSTALLED。Workflow: (1) render Innovus TCL; (2) run via innovus -no_gui -files; (3) parse DRC/连接性。触发场景：(1) bba-guru-pd routed 后做 in-flow DRC/connectivity；(2) streamOut GDS 前查 DRC；(3) 显式 /bb-invoke-physverify。

name: bb-invoke-qrouter
description: 调用 QRouter 1.4 对 placed DEF 执行 detail routing，产出 routed.def。触发场景：(1) bba-guru-pd 在 placement 完成后做布线；(2) 显式 /bb-invoke-qrouter。

name: bb-invoke-quantus
description: 通过 Innovus wrapper 调用 Cadence Quantus QRC/extractRC 做寄生参数提取（RC/RC*C），产出 SPEF 供 Innovus timing/rail-analysis 使用。Chiplet_Server 上 direct quantus 不在 PATH，安装树内 binary 直接运行缺 wrapper 库环境；本 skill 必须走 `innovus -no_gui -files`。Workflow: (1) render TCL; (2) run via Innovus; (3) parse SPEF + RC summary。触发场景：(1) bba-guru-pd routed 后做 post-route SPEF；(2) timing/rail-analysis 需要独立 SPEF；(3) 显式 /bb-invoke-quantus。

name: bb-invoke-tempus

name: bb-invoke-xcelium

Use when reporting treatment effects in confirmatory trials, comparing effect sizes across studies, or constructing forest plots.

name: bio-clinical-biostatistics-effect-measures

Use when modeling binary or ordinal endpoints in confirmatory or exploratory clinical trials.

name: bio-clinical-biostatistics-logistic-regression

Use when handling missing primary or secondary endpoint data in regulatory submissions following NRC 2010 and ICH E9(R1).

name: bio-clinical-biostatistics-multiplicity-graphical

Covers FDA Multiple Endpoints Final Guidance (October 2022), graphical procedures via R gMCP, primary + key-secondary + subgroup hierarchies, and FWER vs FDR distinction. Use when designing the multiplicity strategy for confirmatory trials with multiple primary or key secondary endpoints.

name: bio-clinical-biostatistics-power-sample-size
description: Computes sample size and power for clinical trials including continuous, binary, and time-to-event endpoints; superiority, non-inferiority, and equivalence designs; FDA 2016 non-inferiority margin selection with M1/M2 framework; Schoenfeld 1981 and Lakatos 1988 for survival; Schuirmann TOST and 80-125% bioequivalence; minimum clinically important difference (MCID) vs δ distinction. name: bio-clinical-biostatistics-power-sample-size

name: bio-clinical-biostatistics-subgroup-analysis

name: bio-expression-matrix-metadata-joins
description: Merge sample metadata with count matrices and add gene annotations. Use when preparing data for differential expression analysis or visualization.

name: bio-expression-matrix-normalization
description: Normalizes and transforms RNA-seq count matrices for DE, visualization, clustering, and ML. Covers between-sample (TMM, TMMwsp, RLE/median-of-ratios, upper quartile), within-sample (TPM, FPKM/RPKM), variance-stabilizing (VST, rlog, log-CPM), GC-content correction (cqn, EDASeq), and single-cell (scran deconvolution, scanpy normalize_total). name: bio-expression-matrix-normalization
description: Normalize and transform RNA-seq count matrices for differential expression, visualization, and clustering. Covers between-sample (TMM, RLE, upper quartile), within-sample (TPM, FPKM), variance-stabilizing (VST, rlog), and single-cell (scran) methods. Use when choosing or applying normalization to expression data.

name: bio-flow-cytometry-clustering-phenotyping
description: Unsupervised clustering and cell-type identification for high-dimensional flow, spectral, and mass cytometry - FlowSOM, PhenoGraph, FlowSOM-via-CATALYST, with UMAP/tSNE for visualization. Covers the type-vs-state marker distinction (cluster on lineage, test state within clusters), over-provision-then-metacluster, the Weber-Robinson benchmark, seed dependence and metacluster stability, why embeddings are for looking not measuring, and median-heatmap annotation/merging. description: Spillover compensation and data transformation for flow cytometry. Covers compensation matrix calculation, application, and biexponential/arcsinh transforms. Use when correcting spectral overlap between fluorophores or transforming data for analysis.

name: bio-flow-cytometry-compensation-transformation
description: Corrects fluorophore spillover (conventional compensation) or spectral overlap (spectral unmixing) and applies variance-stabilizing transforms (logicle/biexponential, arcsinh, log) for flow and mass cytometry. Covers spillover-matrix estimation from single-stain controls, AutoSpill, the spillover spreading matrix and why panel design (not compensation) bounds resolution, compensate-then-transform ordering, and arcsinh cofactor choice (5 for CyTOF, ~150 for fluorescence, per-channel via flowVS). name: bio-flow-cytometry-cytometry-qc

name: bio-flow-cytometry-cytometry-qc
description: Quality control for flow, spectral, and mass cytometry - time-based anomaly cleaning (flowAI, flowCut, PeacoQC, flowClean), margin/boundary event removal, signal-drift detection, dead-cell exclusion, CyTOF Gaussian/DNA/event-length checks, instrument calibration/standardization (MESF, CS&T, peak-2), and batch-level outlier flagging. name: bio-flow-cytometry-differential-analysis

À utiliser quand l'utilisateur cherche un moyen rapide de se calmer ou demande un exercice de relaxation. Se déclenche aussi avec "exercice de respiration", "je veux me calmer", "technique de relaxation", "cohérence cardiaque", "respiration carrée", "j'ai besoin de me poser", ou toute demande d'outil de régulation émotionnelle immédiat. Also triggers on "breathing exercise", "calm down now", "box breathing".

name: breathing-exercise-guide
description: Provides structured breathing exercise programs for stress relief, sleep improvement, focus enhancement, and anxiety management. Includes step-by-step guided instructions for various techniques. Use when the user wants breathing exercises, asks about breathwork, or needs quick relaxation techniques.

name: breathing-exercises
description: Teaches specific named breathing techniques (box breathing 4-4-4-4, diaphragmatic breathing, 4-7-8 breathing, physiological sigh) with step-by-step sequences, timing, and use-case matching. Gathers the user's goal (calm down, energize, sleep, focus) and produces a complete breathing protocol with technique instructions and a practice schedule. Use when the user asks about breathing exercises, breathwork techniques, deep breathing for relaxation, calming breathing patterns, or breath control methods. Do NOT use for clinical respiratory therapy, hyperventilation treatment, or breathing exercise…

name: breathing-ground
description: 情绪急救——从爆发降到能呼吸。当用户处于焦虑、恐慌、情绪淹没状态时，带 ta 用呼吸和 grounding 先缓下来。触发场景：慌、喘不上气、心跳好快、受不了了、要崩溃了、好害怕、停不下来、脑子一片空白、快要爆发、身体明显激活。

name: breathing-room
description: Show the user where their own week has room to breathe and where it does not, from their calendar, their sent mail and their sent Teams messages. Use this skill when the user asks how their day or week looks, whether they are overloaded, where their free blocks are, whether they still have deep-work time, how much they are working outside hours or at weekends, what the coming week already looks like, or - when they ask - which meetings are the most movable. It recognises time off and does not flag or count leave. Runs in three scopes - today, week, ahead. This skill only ever looks at the use…

name: breathing-room
description: Quick, lossy compaction of an in-progress work session's accumulated context — long tool outputs, file dumps, exploratory dead ends, superseded reasoning — into a terse working note that preserves only what's needed to keep going, meaning the current goal, decided facts, state of progress, and next step. Use whenever the user asks to compact, trim, or free up context, says things like "give me some breathing room" or "compact this," or when a session has accumulated a lot of large tool outputs and file contents that are no longer being actively referenced. This is deliberately quick and dirty…

name: breathing-sync
description: Create and validate breathing-synchronized features for breathe-together-v2. Mode 1 creates visual features responding to UTC-based global breathing cycle (inhale/hold/exhale/hold). Mode 2 validates and debugs why entities aren't responding visibly to breathing synchronization. Includes integration patterns, ECS trait querying, system registration, damping/easing, and systematic 8-point validation.
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash(npm run dev:*), mcp__context7__*

name: Breathwork Seminar Marketing Speech Generation
description: Generates persuasive pep talks for specific audiences (such as corporate clients or police departments) to hire the speaker for a breath detox seminar, emphasizing specific benefits and the speaker's credentials.

name: breathwork-practitioner
description: Guide breathwork practices including box breathing, coherent breathing, technique comparisons, safety considerations, and progressive training plans for stress management and performance. Use when the user asks about breathwork practitioner, related techniques, best practices, or needs guidance in this domain. Do NOT use when the request is outside the scope of breathwork practitioner or requires a different specialized skill.

name: breathwork-session
description: Create a breathwork session with structured process, quality checks, and system integration

name: brecahad-mimic-iv-fusion-eval
description: Evaluates a multimodal framework's ability to fuse patch-level histopathology features with structured EHR data for early breast cancer diagnosis, specifically probing performance on class-imbalanced minority classes like mitosis. Use when the user wants to benchmark on BreCaHAD, MIMIC-IV, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Macro-average AUC.

name: breccia-add-component
description: Add a new component type to the Breccia engine end to end (data, serialization, systems, editor, Lua, tests, docs). Use when a feature needs new per-entity data.

name: breccia-build-test
description: Build Breccia, run its unit tests and format check, and verify rendering with Vulkan validation. Use before every commit and after any C++/shader/CMake change.

name: breccia-code-review
description: Pre-commit review checklist for Breccia changes. Use on the staged diff before every commit.

name: breccia-debug-rendering
description: Diagnose rendering problems in Breccia (black/inside-out/flipped images, missing shadows, wrong lighting, validation errors). Use when a screenshot looks wrong or the renderer reports errors.

name: breccia-make-game
description: Build a complete game with the Breccia engine (e.g. "make me Tetris/Breakout/a platformer") using only the breccia CLI or the editor's automation server — no GUI interaction needed. Use whenever asked to create or modify a game, scene, prefab or gameplay script.

name: brecha
description: Protocolo de respuesta ante brechas de seguridad de datos personales. Guía el proceso desde la detección hasta la notificación a la AEPD (72 horas, art. 33 RGPD) y la comunicación a los interesados si hay alto riesgo (art. 34 RGPD). Genera checklist de acciones y plantillas de notificación. Usar cuando el usuario dice "brecha de seguridad", "incidente de datos", "notificación AEPD", "nos han hackeado", "fuga de datos", o ante cualquier incidente que afecte a datos personales.

name: brecha
description: Protocolo de respuesta ante brechas de seguridad de datos personales. Guía el proceso desde la detección hasta la notificación conjunta a la ANTAI y a los titulares afectados cuando haya riesgo, en 72 horas, conforme a la Ley 81 de 2019 y el Decreto Ejecutivo 285 de 2021. Genera checklist de acciones y plantillas de notificación. Usar cuando el usuario dice "brecha de seguridad", "incidente de datos", "notificación ANTAI", "nos han hackeado", "fuga de datos", o ante cualquier incidente que afecte a datos personales.

name: brecha-betobetico
description: Protocolo de respuesta ante brechas de seguridad de datos personales. Guía el proceso desde la detección hasta la notificación a la AEPD (72 horas, art. 33 RGPD) y la comunicación a los interesados si hay alto riesgo (art. 34 RGPD). Genera checklist de acciones y plantillas de notificación. Usar cuando el usuario dice "brecha de seguridad", "incidente de datos", "notificación AEPD", "nos han hackeado", "fuga de datos", o ante cualquier incidente que afecte a datos personales.

name: brecha-evaluacion-severidad
description: Evalúa la severidad de una brecha de datos personales para los titulares con la metodología ENISA (contexto de los datos × facilidad de identificación + circunstancias) y decide, según el art. 34 del Reglamento de la Ley 29733 (D.S. 016-2024-JUS), si hay que notificar a la ANPD, comunicar a los titulares y reportar al CNSD. Úsalo cuando se pregunte "¿qué tan grave es?", "¿tenemos que notificar?" o cuando el triaje confirme una brecha.

name: brecha-notificacion
description: Redacta los borradores de notificación de una brecha de datos personales a la Autoridad Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales (ANPD), la comunicación a los titulares afectados en lenguaje claro y el aviso al Centro Nacional de Seguridad Digital, con el contenido mínimo del art. 34 del Reglamento de la Ley 29733 y control de plazos de 48 horas. Úsalo cuando se pida "notificar la brecha", "redactar el aviso a los afectados" o cuando la evaluación de severidad indique que hay que notificar.

name: brecha-respuesta-cierre
description: Elabora el plan de respuesta a un incidente o brecha de seguridad (contención, preservación de evidencia y cadena de custodia, erradicación y recuperación) y el informe de cierre con causa raíz, lecciones aprendidas y controles ISO/IEC 27002 propuestos, dejando el registro que exige el art. 35 del Reglamento de la Ley 29733. Úsalo cuando se pida "cómo contenemos esto", "plan de respuesta", "informe post-incidente", "lecciones aprendidas" o "cerrar el incidente".

name: brecha-triaje
description: Recibe el reporte de un evento o posible incidente de seguridad (correo enviado por error, ransomware, laptop robada, acceso indebido, phishing, aviso de un proveedor) y determina si es un evento, un incidente de seguridad o una brecha de datos personales. Lo clasifica, prioriza, inicia el reloj de 48 horas y abre la ficha del incidente. Úsalo cuando alguien reporte algo que "pasó" con información o sistemas, aunque no diga "incidente" ni "brecha".

name: brechas
description: Cruza las dependencias del proyecto (pnpm-lock.yaml o package-lock.json), los servidores MCP y la versión de Claude Code con avisos públicos de seguridad (OSV.dev con GitHub Advisory Database y paquetes maliciosos, CISA KEV, EPSS) y deja un reporte con links en docs/seguridad/. Úsala cuando pidan revisar brechas, CVEs, vulnerabilidades o paquetes maliciosos en las dependencias, y cuando blindar delegue la parte de dependencias.

name: bredballeif-boerneattest
description: Kontrollér read-only godkendelsesdatoer for børneattester på frivillige i Bredballe IF via Conventus. Brug ved bestyrelsens kontrol af børneattester, afdelingslister, U15-trænere, manglende eller forældede godkendelsesdatoer, fællesgruppen 1002724 og årsrapporten til 1. februar-erklæringen. Skillen indhenter, registrerer eller sender ikke CPR-numre, børneattester eller andre følsomme oplysninger.

name: bredballeif-fondsansoegning
description: Opbyg og vedligehold Bredballe IF's danske fonds- og puljeindeks, udvikl et ansøgningsklart projekt, match relevante muligheder og lav op til ti selvstændige fondsspecifikke ansøgninger med aktuelle krav, kilder, bilag, godkendelse og indsendelseslog. Brug skillen ved fondsresearch, fundraising, puljesøgning, projektbrief, budget, tidligere ansøgninger, Fundraising Club, fondsansøgninger eller batch af flere ansøgninger.

name: bredballeif-oekonomi
description: Lav afdelingsbudgetter, budgetopfølgning og samlede PDF-rapporter for Bredballe IF ud fra read-only finansdata i Conventus. Brug ved opfølgning for en afdeling eller alle afdelinger, med afvigelser i kroner og procent, foreslåede ratinger og spørgsmål til bestyrelsen.

name: bredballeif-padel-baner
description: Tjek om Bredballe IF Padels baner (SPORT 24, Sydbank, home Vejle) er ledige på en bestemt dato og evt. tidsrum — og book baner. Brug når bestyrelsesmedlemmer spørger om en padelbane er fri. Trigger: ledig bane, er der en bane fri, banebelægning, padelbane, book en bane, ledige tider.

name: bredballeif-padel-conventus
description: Vis medlemmer direkte i en autentificeret Conventus-browser, hent og analyser Bredballe IF-data via XML API eller kontrolleret web-udtræk, og administrer grupper via Conventus-hjemmesiden. Brug til padelmedlemmer, medlemslister, alle medlemmer i en konkret gruppe via gruppe-ID, grupper, medlemstal, churn og retention, redigering eller oprettelse af grupper samt read-only resultatopgørelser og finansdata til budget og budgetopfølgning.

name: bredballeif-padel-halbooking
description: Administrer Bredballe IF Padel-medlemmer i HalBooking via Playwright browser automation. Brug til at søge medlemmer, hente detaljer, se medlemskabshistorik, oprette medlemmer, eksportere medlemmer, tjekke HalBooking preflight og arbejde med HalBooking admin-sider.

name: bredballeif-padel-kontingent-beregner
description: Beregn, validér og diff sæsonvægtede prime- og non-prime-kontingenter for Bredballe IF Padel uden at skrive til Conventus eller andre systemer. Brug når agenten bredballeif-padel-administrator skal justere padel-kontingenter, kontrollere månedlige priser, finde aktiv/inaktiv status for "til og med 30. juni" eller "resten af året", eller returnere struktureret JSON til efterfølgende opdatering via andre skills.

name: bredballeif-padel-onboarding
description: Onboard Bredballe IF Padel-medlemmer og frivillige på tværs af Conventus, HalBooking og Gmail. Brug til fuld SOP: slå person op i Conventus, godkend betalende medlem eller gratis frivillig fra gruppen Padel Frivillige, opret eller find personen i HalBooking, tildel prime/non-prime medlemskab, generer eller send velkomstmail, processer Conventus-notifikationer og kør preflight.

name: bredballeif-vedtaegter
description: Fortolk og anvend Bredballe IFs vedtægter til at afklare ansvar, kompetence, beslutningsgange og administrative pligter for generalforsamlingen, bestyrelsen, forretningsudvalget og afdelingerne. Brug ved spørgsmål om en paragraf, især § 15, om bestyrelsens eller afdelingernes ansvar, eller når en vedtægtsbestemt opgave skal kontrolleres, planlægges eller udføres, fx generalforsamling, afdelingsmøde, årsberetning, handlingsplan, budgetforslag, forretningsorden, medlemsforhold, beslutningsoplæg eller årshjul.

name: bredvid-andra-sessioner
description: Använd i dealer-repot när arbetet startar i en session eller underagent medan andra sessioner skriver i samma repo - innan en fil ändras, en gren eller ett arbetsträd görs, en ny modul under src/ importeras, ett meddelande skickas till en annan session, eller headless Chrome, grafikkortet eller många testarbetare används. Gäller varje session som inte är huvudagenten, och huvudagenten när den delar ut arbete.

name: bredy-anime-reel
description: 브리디 동물(고양이·강아지·크레·햄스터)이 한국 사람 누구나 아는 애니 명장면을 패러디하는 16~25초 릴스·쇼츠를 만든다. 기획 관문(아는 장면·원작 OST·웃음 대비 한 줄) → 비트 단위 콘티 → Veo 클립 생성 → 자막·리듬 편집 → 사용자 미리보기 확인 → 게시까지. 사용자가 '애니 패러디 릴스', '애니 명장면 숏폼', '명장면 동물 버전', '애니 밈 영상 만들어' 등을 요청할 때 쓴다. 매일 유행 밈 영상은 bredy-meme-reel, 매물 홍보 카드는 bredy-sns-promo.

name: bredy-app-deploy
description: 브리디 앱(bredy_app, Expo)을 운영에 내보낸다. JS 만 바뀌었으면 코드푸시(EAS Update)로 바로 내고, 네이티브가 바뀌었으면 Android·iOS 스토어 빌드(EAS 클라우드, Android 한도 소진 시 로컬 빌드)를 만들어 Play 프로덕션·App Store 심사까지 제출한다. 사전 검사, 웹 선배포 확인, 버전·출시 노트, 런타임 기록, 태그까지 한다. 사용자가 '앱 배포해줘', '브리디 앱 배포', '다음 버전 빌드해서 업데이트', '스토어 올려줘', '플레이스토어 올려줘', '앱스토어 제출', 'iOS 배포', '코드푸시', 'OTA 업데이트', '앱 수정 바로 반영' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 웹(breeder_web) 배포는 breeder-web-deploy 스킬, 스토어 스크린샷 디자인은 bredy_app docs/store-screenshots.md 를 따른다.

name: bredy-cafe-activity
description: 브리디 운영자 네이버 계정으로 생물 카페(물생활 홈다리·파충류 파사모·곤충 개미마을)의 최근 질문글에 정보성 답 댓글을 달고, 같은 주제로 네이버 블로그(bredy_team) 정보글을 써서 댓글 끝에 그 블로그 링크를 남긴다(블로그 글 끝에서 브리디로 연결). 질문 고르기 → 본문·댓글 읽기 → 블로그 글 발행 → 카페 댓글 → 기록·보고까지 한다. 사용자가 '카페 활동해줘', '카페 활동', '카페 질문에 답 달아줘', '홈다리 댓글', '파사모 댓글', '카페에 정보 댓글', '카페 영업' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 브리디 앱 안 커뮤니티에 크루 계정으로 글을 쓰는 일은 bredy-crew-activity 스킬, 인스타 DM 영업은 bredy-instagram-outreach 스킬 담당.

name: bredy-cafe-research
description: 브리디 시장조사용으로 네이버 카페(식물·강아지·고양이·물고기·거북이·소동물 등) 최근 글의 제목·본문·사진을 브리디 자동화 크롬(9222) 네이버 로그인으로 수집하고, 카페별 글 수·반응·게시판·많이 나온 말·분양 비중·가격을 집계한다. 종별 대표 카페 찾기 → 활동량 확인 → 수집(글 사이 3~5초, 이어받기) → 잠긴 글 점검 → 집계 보고(report.md)까지 한다. 사용자가 '카페 크롤링', '카페 글 수집', '○○ 카페 30개 긁어줘', '네이버 카페 시장조사', '카페 사진이랑 글 받아줘', '카페 집계' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 카페에 댓글·글을 다는 일은 bredy-cafe-activity, 로봇천국 카페 운영은 robot-cafe-content 담당.

name: bredy-content
description: 브리디(bredy.app) 인스타그램·쓰레드용 마케팅 콘텐츠(카드뉴스 이미지 4:5, 15초 릴스 영상 9:16)를 브랜드 템플릿으로 만들고, 영업 멘트·콘텐츠 캘린더·자동 게시 설계를 다룬다. 사용자가 '브리디 카드뉴스', '브리디 릴스', '인스타 콘텐츠 만들어줘', '오늘 콘텐츠', '쓰레드 게시물', '분양/경매/동네 브리더/혈통 홍보', '마케팅 자동화', '영업 멘트' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다.

name: bredy-crew-activity
description: 브레디 크루(운영 계정)로 반려생활 커뮤니티에 활동한다. 생물 분류마다 정보·댓글·토론·질문 역할을 맡은 크루가 있다. 실행할 때마다 최근 글을 읽고, 역할에 맞는 새 글·찬반 토론과 글 내용에 맞는 댓글·좋아요·팔로우(필요하면 혈통) 계획을 짜서, AI 냄새 검사(lint)와 사람 말투 다듬기를 거쳐 사용자 확인 뒤 API 로 실행한다. "크루 활동", "운영 계정 활동", "커뮤니티 채우기", "크루 글 AI 냄새", "크루 프로필 바꿔"를 요청할 때 쓴다.

name: bredy-feature-flow
description: 브리디(bredy_app 앱 + breeder_web 웹·서버)에 새 기능을 기획부터 출시 직전까지 한 번에 만든다. PRD(docs/prd) → 당근 톤 시안 HTML·PNG(design/mockups) → 지정한 사용자군 페르소나 피드백(서브에이전트) → PRD v2 → 서버·웹·앱 동시 구현(마이그레이션은 migrate deploy 만) → 테스트·웹 E2E·에뮬레이터 캡처 → pr-assets 업로드 → 웹 dev PR + 앱 master 푸시(Parity 트레일러) → 문서·메모리 기록까지 한다. 사용자가 '브리디에 ○○ 기능 추가해줘', 'PRD부터 써주고 기획 디자인하고 만들어줘', '20대 여자(○○ 사용자) 피드백 받아서 만들어', '기획→디자인→구현 다 해줘' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 작은 버그 수정·문구 변경, 배포만(bredy-app-deploy·breeder-web-deploy), PRD 문서만(hjjm-prd)에는 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-instagram-outreach
description: 브리디 공식 인스타 계정(bredy_breeder)으로 크레·파충류 브리더·샵·키우는 사람에게만 영업 DM 을 보내고 답장을 처리한다. 브리디 자동화 크롬(scripts/ig.mjs)으로 DM함 답장 정리 → 남은 창립 브리더 자리 확인 → 유형별 공통 문구에 닉네임만 넣어 하루 20명까지 발송 → targets.csv 기록 → 보고까지 한다. name: built-check

Use at the end of a session, when wrapping up, or when the user asks "what did I ship", "did I build any of this", "close the ones I've done", "is anything on the list done", or explicitly invokes /built-check. name: business-explainer

name: business-feature-builder

name: business-feature-context
description: What the product under development DOES for its users, feature by feature: the feature catalog grouped by module, the CRUD matrix (which role can create, read, update or delete which entity, from which screen), the UI inventory (pages, forms, navigation, guards) and the flows that cross several features. Triggers on "feature docs", "business feature documentation", "module documentation", "document feature", "update feature docs".
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, Task, TodoWrite

name: business-feature-docs

allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, Task, TodoWrite

name: business-feature-writing
description: Use when asked for a long-form article, profile, or narrative report in the style of the Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, or a business newspaper feature, about a company, a partnership, a deal, or a founder, and the piece must be built from a fixed record of emails, invoices, and documents rather than from interviews.

name: business-finance

name: bust-injection
description: SQL injection, command injection, template injection, LDAP injection, and other injection vulnerabilities — where user-controlled input is concatenated into a query, command, or template that is then executed.

name: bust-insecure-defaults
description: Security vulnerabilities introduced by insecure default configurations — open CORS policies, weak cryptography settings, missing authentication, disabled TLS verification, and other cases where the "easy" setup is also the insecure one.

name: bust-legacy-patterns
description: Code that uses outdated language patterns — callbacks where async/await is available, `var` instead of `const`/`let`, string concatenation instead of template literals, and other patterns superseded by modern equivalents that are cleaner and safer.

name: bust-logic-errors
description: Incorrect logic that passes tests and linting but produces wrong results — off-by-one errors, inverted conditions, wrong operators (`&&` vs `||`, `>` vs `>=`), incorrect boundary handling, and silent integer/float precision issues. The #1 category of AI-generated code failure.

name: bust-memory-leaks
description: Event listeners not removed, timers not cleared, closures holding references to large objects, unclosed file handles or database connections, and other patterns that prevent the garbage collector from reclaiming memory.

name: bust-missing-auth-check
description: API endpoints that authenticate the caller (verify *who* they are) but forget to authorise the action (verify *whether they're allowed to do this specific thing*). A logged-in user can read, modify, or delete another user's data by simply changing an ID in the request. AI agents reliably generate authentication middleware but almost never add per-resource ownership checks.

name: bust-missing-db-index
description: Database queries on unindexed columns — causing full table scans that are fast in development (100 rows) and catastrophically slow in production (1M rows). AI agents generate queries without knowing the data volume or access patterns, and almost never add indexes.

name: bust-missing-input-validation
description: API endpoints, functions, and handlers that trust all incoming data without validating it — accepting malformed types, out-of-range values, oversized payloads, or missing required fields. AI agents commonly skip validation because the happy-path logic works on the sample data they're given.

name: bust-missing-observability
description: Production code paths with no logging, no metrics, and no alerting — where failures are invisible until a user reports them, where you can't answer "is this working right now?", and where diagnosing an incident requires guesswork instead of data.

name: bust-missing-pagination
description: Queries, APIs, and data fetches that return unbounded result sets — no `LIMIT`, no cursor, no page size — causing out-of-memory crashes, timeouts, and cascading failures as the dataset grows.

name: bust-missing-tests
description: Critical code paths with no test coverage — business logic that runs without tests, edge cases that have never been verified, and new features shipped without any corresponding tests.

description: **Bad:** ```python def transfer_funds(from_id: int, to_id: int, amount: Decimal): sender = Account.objects.get(id=from_id) sender.balance -= amount sender.save() # Committed immediately

name: bust-mutable-defaults
description: Mutable default arguments and shared mutable state that is accidentally shared across all callers — Python's most notorious footgun, and a pattern AI agents reproduce constantly because the code looks correct and passes basic tests. The bug only appears when the function is called more than once.

name: bust-n-plus-one
description: N+1 query patterns — where code executes one query to fetch a list of records and then one additional query per record to fetch related data — causing performance that degrades linearly with the number of records.

name: bust-naming
description: Misleading, abbreviated, cryptic, or non-idiomatic names for variables, functions, classes, and modules — making code harder to read than it needs to be and hiding intent.

name: bust-orm-abuse
description: Misuse of Object-Relational Mappers — both using an ORM where raw SQL would be more appropriate, and writing raw SQL where the ORM would be cleaner and safer.

name: bust-outdated-deps
description: Dependencies that are multiple major versions behind, have known CVEs, have been abandoned by their maintainers, or create transitive vulnerabilities that put the application at risk.

name: bust-over-engineering
description: Solutions that are more complex than the problem requires — abstractions built for hypothetical futures, infrastructure sized for 100x the current load, and patterns applied because they sound impressive rather than because they solve a real problem.

name: bust-pr-hygiene
description: Pull requests that are too large to review, lack context, bundle unrelated changes, or sit open so long they become merge conflict nightmares — all of which lead to superficial reviews and bugs that slip through.

name: bust-race-conditions
description: Check-then-act patterns, non-atomic counter increments, double-submit vulnerabilities, and shared mutable state accessed concurrently — where the gap between "check" and "act" allows another thread or request to invalidate the assumption.

name: bust-stub-code
description: Placeholder, scaffold, or TODO code that was written as a temporary skeleton and accidentally shipped — `throw new Error("not implemented")`, hardcoded return values, `pass` bodies in production paths, and `// TODO: implement` comments in code that is actively called.

name: bust-swallowed-errors
description: Exceptions and errors that are silently caught and discarded — making failures invisible, turning bugs into mystery behaviour, and removing any chance of diagnosis or recovery.

name: bust-tech-debt-hotspots
description: Files and modules that are simultaneously high-churn (changed frequently) and low-quality (low test coverage, high complexity, many bugs) — the areas of the codebase where every change is risky and takes longer than it should.

name: bust-test-quality
description: Two related problems that together make tests useless: tests that exist but verify the wrong things (asserting implementation instead of behaviour), and code that is structurally impossible to test (hidden dependencies, logic buried in I/O, non-determinism). Both produce the same outcome — a green CI that misses real bugs.

name: bust-tight-coupling
description: Components that are so tightly bound to their dependencies that they cannot be tested in isolation, swapped for a different implementation, or reused in a different context.

name: bust-type-safety
description: Type system holes that disable static analysis and allow runtime type errors to slip through — TypeScript `any`, unchecked casts, missing null guards on external data, and Python code that ignores type hints at the boundaries where data enters the system.

name: bust-unnecessary-recompute
description: Expensive computations that are re-run on every render, every request, or every event — when the input hasn't changed and the result could be cached or memoized.

name: bust-wrong-architecture
description: Code structured around an architectural pattern that doesn't fit the problem — making the system harder to understand, extend, and maintain than it needs to be.

name: bust-wrong-framework
description: Using a framework that doesn't match the problem — either too heavy, too light, or simply the wrong tool — leading to unnecessary complexity, fighting the framework, or missing built-in capabilities.

name: bust-wrong-workflow
description: Development workflow practices that slow teams down, introduce risk, or make it impossible to ship safely — including branching strategies that don't match team size, missing CI/CD gates, and deploy practices that have no rollback path.

name: bwdesign
description: Drive the TIBCO BusinessWorks 6.x design-time CLI (bwdesign) to author and manage BW projects from the command line — create/import/export applications and modules, add processes/activities/groups/links, configure module & process properties, shared resources (HTTP/JMS/JNDI), WSDL/SOAP/REST bindings, Swagger operations, tests & assertions, validate, generate pom.xml/diagrams/EARs, and configure MCP. Use whenever the user wants to script or automate BW6 Studio design tasks, or asks how to run bwdesign / a specific bwdesign command.

name: BWE-ALL-ENGINES-CHECK
description: Takes a website project name and reports whether the SEO Engine, FAQ Engine or Blog Engine installed in it needs updating, by comparing the installed version with the latest in each BWERepo engine repo. Read-only. Use when the user says "check engine versions", "does the site name need engine updates", "are the engines up to date", or invokes /BWE-ALL-ENGINES-CHECK.

name: BWE-ALL-ENGINES-INSTALL
description: Installs or updates the latest SEO Engine, FAQ Engine and Blog Engine (each fetched from its BWERepo GitHub repo on every run) into one chosen website in a single run, then reports the installed version of each. Use when the user says "install all engines", "install all 3 engines", "install SEO, FAQ and Blog engines in the site name", or invokes /BWE-ALL-ENGINES-INSTALL. Never deploys.

name: BWE-BACKUP
description: Backs up the current project folder to a timestamped zip file, including git history, and leaves out rebuildable folders and secrets. Use when the user says "back up this project", "backup", or invokes /BWE-BACKUP, in any project. For the One Click Answers project use BWE-OCA-BACKUP instead.

name: BWE-BLOG
description: The Blog Engine front door. Reads the current website's real Blog Engine state (bwe-blog status), shows a short status dashboard (stage, what is done, what needs the owner), recommends the ONE best next step with the exact command, then asks before proceeding. Never selects, generates, approves or publishes anything on its own. Use when the user says "blog", "Blog Engine", "work on the blog", "what's next for the blog", "blog status", "where are we with the blog", or invokes /BWE-BLOG, in any website project.

name: BWE-BLOG-ENGINE
description: Blog Engine control panel. Actions - version, installed, install, update. Use when the user says "Blog engine version", "which sites have the Blog engine", "install or update the latest Blog engine in the site name", or invokes /BWE-BLOG-ENGINE.

name: BWE-BLOG-GENERATE
description: Runs the Blog Engine's analyze, recommend, select and generate steps for the current website, always with the owner choosing which articles to write. Never approves or publishes. Use when the user says "generate blog articles", "recommend blog topics", "write the selected articles", or invokes /BWE-BLOG-GENERATE, in any website project.

name: BWE-BLOG-PUBLISH
description: Publishes approved blog articles through the Blog Engine's validation gate and rebuilds the blog SEO index. Publishes only articles the owner named; never deploys. Use when the user says "publish the blog article", "publish the post", or invokes /BWE-BLOG-PUBLISH, in any website project.

name: BWE-BLOG-REVIEW
description: Guides the owner through reviewing and approving generated blog drafts, using the Blog Engine's admin dashboard and link report. Approves only on the owner's explicit say-so. Use when the user says "review the blog drafts", "approve the article", or invokes /BWE-BLOG-REVIEW, in any website project.

name: BWE-BLOG-SETUP
description: Sets up the Blog Engine's configuration for the current website (siteUrl, approval mode, article limits, AI provider choice by name only). Never stores keys. Use when the user says "set up the blog", "configure the blog engine", or invokes /BWE-BLOG-SETUP, in any website project.

name: BWE-CLAUDE-HUNG
description: Diagnoses whether another Claude Code session is hung (waiting for something that will never happen) or still working, and reports what it is doing. Run it from a SECOND session while the first looks stuck. Use when the user says "is claude hung", "is it stuck", "is it still running", "what is claude doing", or invokes /BWE-CLAUDE-HUNG (optionally with a project folder name, session id, or "all").

name: BWE-CLAUDE-STATUS
description: Summarizes the current status of this Claude session: what Claude itself (the main session) is working on right now, and a one-line description of what each agent (subagent, teammate or other local Claude session) is doing, with its state (running, idle, done). Use when the user says "status", "what is Claude doing", "what are the agents doing", "who is working", or invokes /BWE-CLAUDE-STATUS, in any project.

name: BWE-EXPORT
description: Exports the current project's threads (title, status, what was asked and done, pull requests, what waits on the owner, next steps) plus the standing rules to ONE text file that /BWE-IMPORT can read in another session. Use when the user says "export the threads", "hand off to a new session", or invokes /BWE-EXPORT. Changes nothing else.

name: BWE-FAQ
description: The FAQ front door and coordinator. Reads the current website's real FAQ Engine state (faq-engine status), shows a short status dashboard (stage, FAQ counts by status, what needs the owner, last validation), recommends the ONE best next step and the skill that does it, then asks before proceeding. Guides the owner through installing the engine and creating the FAQ pages step by step, never skipping a review gate, never publishing an answer the site does not support. Use when the user says "FAQ", "FAQs", "work on the FAQ page", "what's next for the FAQ", "FAQ status", "where are we with FAQs",…

name: BWE-FAQ-ENGINE

name: BWE-FAQ-GENERATE

Use when the user says "generate FAQs", "create the FAQs", "scan the site for FAQs", "propose FAQs", or invokes /BWE-FAQ-GENERATE, after /BWE-FAQ-SETUP.

name: BWE-FAQ-PUBLISH
description: Gets the FAQ page working on the site and ready to publish - helps wire the engine's rendered FAQ HTML, stylesheet and script into the site's FAQ page, then builds the SEO export and runs the engine's validation, and walks the owner through the final check before they publish. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur demande de rédiger ou compléter des exigences, des spécifications, un cahier des charges, des user stories ou des critères d'acceptation (requirements, specifications, acceptance criteria). Fait partie de la famille cadrage-projet.

name: cadrage-faisabilite

À utiliser quand l'utilisateur demande si un projet est faisable ou réaliste, une analyse de risques, une vérification réglementaire (RGPD, normes, obligations sectorielles) ou un avis avant d'engager des moyens (feasibility study, risk analysis, compliance check). Fait partie de la famille cadrage-projet.

Propose un planning d'investigation quand la solution n'est pas encore définie. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur demande un planning, un rétroplanning, un calendrier, une estimation de charge, de coût ou de délai, ou veut savoir si une date butoir est tenable (project planning, schedule, estimate, roadmap). Fait partie de la famille cadrage-projet.

À utiliser quand l'utilisateur veut lancer, clarifier, cadrer, structurer, reprendre ou réorienter un projet, demande par où commencer…
